sql:
SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_first_order then member_id end) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when not is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_validity" order_validity_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_17
answer: 2026年7月（统计窗口2026-07-01至2026-08-01，青禾合成测试数据，统计单位为CRM会员账户，未额外按门店等条件筛选）：观测期首购会员数为473个账户；观测期首单数为473单；观测期后续购买订单数为29,524单；有效订单数为29,997单。口径说明：有效订单指已支付且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单，取消和全额退款不计；首购会员数为首次有效订单落在7月内的不同CRM账户数（不代表终身首购）；首单数为各账户第一笔有效订单落入7月的单数；后续购买订单数为各账户第二笔及以后的有效订单按订单日期落入7月计数的单数。
question: 2026年7月青禾的观测期首购会员数、观测期首单数、观测期后续购买订单数、有效订单数分别是多少?
